method: Reproducible explicit rare-event inspections. A real loaded window is selected from its deterministic seed and upcoming owner-time pause, independent of gaze. Ice on/off comparison holds date/camera, disables only the ice uniform for inspection, and never changes collision geometry. Discharge frames are emitted by the actual scheduler under manually chosen storm, with declared accelerated inspection pre-roll, no artificial screen overlay.

moon.model: Schlyter approximate topocentric orbit; shared M11 date

character.receiver: landscape only; actor receives landscape map

rain.model: mapped roof upper envelope and loaded ground; roof slopes and leaf interception approximate

lanterns.provenance: Sparse original artistic fixtures at interpreted procedural doors; not documented lamps, occupancy or surveyed lighting. One-sided prepared ground patches, no dynamic lights.
